title: VLA-HWBench: Where the Time Goes When VLA Models Run on Edge Hardware
abstract: arXiv:2610.34717v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision--language--action (VLA) models increasingly run on edge devices aboard robots, where inference latency constrains closed-loop robot control. However, it remains unclear how to design VLA models, their inference software and edge hardware so that robots can run VLA inference in real time. Most VLA models report only task success, while prior studies cover limited action-generation strategies, divide inference into at most three stages, and lack comparisons of inference optimizations on the same models.benchmarking 18 open VLA models across released and alternative backends on NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor and AMD Ryzen AI Max+ PRO 395, with a seven-stage inference breakdown. Our study reveals three insights. First, action-generation strategy matters more than model size. It dominates 14 of 19 Jetson configurations, latency varies by $82\times$ on Jetson and $157\times$ on AMD, and parameter count explains at most 15% of latency variance

translated_title: VLA-HWBench：VLA模型在边缘硬件上运行时的时间都花在哪里
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型越来越多地部署在机器人搭载的边缘设备上，推理延迟制约着闭环机器人控制。然而，如何设计VLA模型、其推理软件和边缘硬件，使机器人能够实时运行VLA推理，目前仍不明确。大多数VLA模型仅报告任务成功率，而已有研究涵盖的动作生成策略有限，最多将推理划分为三个阶段，且缺乏在相同模型上对推理优化效果的比较。本研究在NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor和AMD Ryzen AI Max+ PRO 395两种平台上，对18个开源VLA模型在官方发布后端和替代后端上进行了基准测试，并采用七阶段推理分解方法。我们的研究揭示了三点洞见。第一，动作生成策略比模型规模更重要。它在Jetson上19种配置中的14种里占主导地位，延迟在Jetson上差异高达82倍，在AMD上高达157倍，而参数量最多只能解释15%的延迟方差。
tldr: 该论文提出了VLA-HWBench基准，通过七阶段推理分解在两种边缘硬件平台上对18个开源VLA模型进行测试，发现动作生成策略对推理延迟的影响远大于模型规模。
en_tdlr: VLA-HWBench benchmarks 18 open VLA models across two edge hardware platforms with a seven-stage inference breakdown, revealing that action-generation strategy dominates inference latency far more than model size.
